pages.raw_title: Samurai - The ONE Group - Hospitality Services
pages.raw_meta: Experience the bold flavors and traditional techniques of Samurai. Our menu brings a modern twist to Japanese dining in a stylish, inviting atmosphere.
raw_blocks: A dining experience unlike any other
Close up of sushi on a plate, a roll plucked up by a chopstick; a Samurai chef smiles as he cooks various meats, seafoods, and vegetables. Text appears: Sense a crave?
At Samurai, every meal is a story.

For more than four decades, Samurai has provided a distinctive dining experience. Our skilled personal chefs masterfully perform the ancient art of teppanyaki right before your eyes. The air fills with the sizzle of razor-sharp blades slicing through tender steak, juicy chicken, and savory vegetables—all prepared right at your table. Our sushi chefs artfully prepare a wide variety of signature sushi and sashimi, using only hand-selected, high-quality ingredients. If you’re looking for something to quench your thirst, we feature a diverse array of handcrafted cocktails, wine, beer, and sake. Whether you’re celebrating a birthday, a promotion, or simply enjoying a meal, Samurai is the perfect restaurant for any occasion.

pages.raw_title: Benihana - The ONE Group - Hospitality Services
pages.raw_meta: Experience Benihana, where expert chefs create unforgettable teppanyaki dining moments. Discover our blend of entertainment and culinary mastery that brings people together.
raw_blocks: Benihana chef twirls spatulas while he cooks as customers sit nearby smiling, and enjoying their food and drinks. Text says: "Benihana - memories in the making."
At Benihana, it's not just a meal, it's an experience.
A cultural icon with 77 Benihana restaurants in the United States, Caribbean, and Central and South America.

At Benihana, we celebrate what each guest brings to the table. Whether it’s your family, friends, appetites, or enthusiasm, we’re here to transform every meal into a memorable experience. Our skilled teppanyaki chefs prepare your meal right before your eyes. Our USDA Choice steaks are aged to perfection, and our sauces, salad dressings, and crisp vegetables are all made from scratch. Our sushi chefs expertly craft a diverse selection of signature sushi and sashimi using hand-selected, high-quality ingredients. And if you’re thirsty, explore our variety of handcrafted cocktails, wine, beer, and of course, sake. Beyond food, we’re passionate about entertaining you.

The BENIHANA name is well known throughout the world, famous for the art of teppanyaki cooking and its unrivaled guest experience. The brand has grown from one teppanyaki restaurant in New York City in 1964 to 77 restaurants in the United States, Central and South America (excluding Mexico), and the Caribbean as of March 2025, with more company-owned and franchised restaurants being planned. Ready to be part of the Benihana brand? Get in touch with us today.
